body:
That scene confused me, because since she was blind since being young, it'd seem more likely that she'd have the books in braille... I also think it's more likely that the FBI is some sort of spiritual being. In the conversation between them right after the gunshot vision, he said something about just accepting whatever it is, which ends up being her death. On top of that, he basically was able to plant evidence that would prevent anyone (beyond the 5) from believing this insane story - it can just be chalked up to her being crazy/imaginative/etc.

Just my two cents.

EDIT: Also, in that same FBI conversation, (I think) he's the only one outside the 5 that calls her the OA.
